patterns: The only on-topic APPSC PYQ (G1 2024) is a multi-statement item mixing Survey facts: ICAR-NRCB Best State Award for banana exports, CORS resurvey technology, deficit claims as traps.
Expect APPSC to ask AP's ranks (fruit/egg 1st, raw silk 2nd), headline GSDP / per capita figures, and award/scheme facts from the latest SES.
Price basis (current vs constant) and estimate stage (FAE/FRE) are the classic traps; app MCQs drill these numbers heavily.
Most filed PYQs are generic India population-density items from other PSCs, not Survey questions.
